changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Update menu_promotion_mapping table to support timezone-aware scheduling for UTC implementation
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE menu_promotion_mapping ALTER COLUMN valid_from TYPE timestamptz USING (valid_from AT TIME ZONE 'UTC');
ALTER TABLE menu_promotion_mapping ALTER COLUMN valid_to TYPE timestamptz USING (valid_to AT TIME ZONE 'UTC');

COMMENT ON COLUMN menu_promotion_mapping.valid_from IS 'Promotion validity start date and time in UTC'; COMMENT ON COLUMN menu_promotion_mapping.valid_to IS 'Promotion validity end date and time in UTC';

rollback.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN menu_promotion_mapping.valid_from IS NULL; COMMENT ON COLUMN menu_promotion_mapping.valid_to IS NULL;

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Add performance indexes for UTC promotion scheduling queries
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_menu_promotion_mapping_valid_from ON public.menu_promotion_mapping(valid_from);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_menu_promotion_mapping_valid_to ON public.menu_promotion_mapping(valid_to);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_menu_promotion_mapping_active ON public.menu_promotion_mapping(valid_from, valid_to);
